combat.welcome_log: GEARBOX DUNGEON — Ignition ready. Select a chassis to begin your run.
combat.tour_step_1_keys: DRAG CARD UP OR ONTO ENEMY  •  [X] BURN (+1K RPM)
combat.tour_step_1_body:
No Mana: every card shows its compatible Gears on the top strip and gains or spends RPM.
Drag a glowing card up to play it—or hover any card and press [X] to burn it for +1,000 RPM!
combat.tour_step_2_keys: DRAG KNOB  •  [E / R-SHIFT] UP  •  [Q / L-SHIFT] DOWN
combat.tour_step_2_body:
1 Free Synchro Shift (+/-1 gear) per turn grants +5 Inertia DMG to your next attack.
Staying in the same gear 2+ turns triggers Gear Lugging (+1 Heat); extra steps cause Gear Grind (+1 Heat, -3 HP).
combat.tour_step_3_keys: GREEN = REV-MATCH (+4 SHD, +3 DMG)  •  RED = +4 DMG (+1 HEAT)  •  HOT >=2 = +2 DMG
combat.tour_step_3_body:
Shift into green Optimal RPM for Rev-Match (+4 Shield, +3 DMG). Redline boosts all attacks +4 DMG (+1 Heat).
Warm Engine (2+ Heat) adds +2 DMG, but 5/5 = OVERHEAT (-15 HP). Shift to Neutral (N) to cool -2 Heat!
combat.tour_step_4_keys: DRAG CARD ONTO TARGET  •  [WASD / RIGHT-DRAG] LOOK AROUND
combat.tour_step_4_body:
Enemy plates telegraph their next move (Damage, Shield, RPM Drain, or Gear Lock).
Drag single-target attacks directly onto the hostile vehicle you want to strike.
combat.tour_step_5_body:
Displays Hull HP, Shield, and Scrap. Left sockets hold passive Relics;
right sockets hold single-use Canisters (Nitro, Cryo, Repair) usable anytime for free!
combat.tour_step_6_keys: [TAB] MAP ZOOM  •  [1 / 2] FORKS  •  [I] INSPECT DECK  •  [M] MUTE
combat.tour_step_6_body:
Left Sat-Nav [TAB] previews the 11-sector route and steers road junctions.
Center MFD switches between ENGINE log, GEARS table, GLOSSARY, and Deck queue [I].
combat.tour_step_7_keys: CLICK RED SLAM BUTTON  •  [SPACE] END TURN  •  [H] REOPEN GUIDE
combat.tour_step_7_body:
When your maneuvers are done—and the button does NOT flash STALL RISK!—hit SLAM or [SPACE].
Press [H] anytime in combat to reopen this Cockpit Guide. Good hunting!
combat.quick_tour_step_1_keys: DRAG CARD UP OR ONTO TARGET  •  [X] BURN +1K RPM
combat.quick_tour_step_1_body:
No Mana: every card shows compatible Gears on the top strip and gains or spends RPM.
Drag a glowing card above the dash—or onto a hostile vehicle—to strike!
combat.quick_tour_step_2_keys: DRAG H-GATE KNOB  •  [E / R-SHIFT] UP  •  [Q / L-SHIFT] DOWN
combat.quick_tour_step_2_body:
1 Free Shift (+/-1 gear) each turn gives +5 Inertia DMG; staying in the same gear 2+ turns builds +1 Heat.
Shift into green Optimal RPM for Rev-Match (+4 Shield, +3 DMG) or dodge enemy hits with the right gear!
combat.quick_tour_step_3_keys: CLICK RED SLAM BUTTON  •  [SPACE] END TURN  •  [H] FULL GUIDE
combat.quick_tour_step_3_body:
Hit SLAM or [SPACE] when ready (avoid ending a turn with STALL RISK!).
Press [H] anytime in combat to open the full 7-step Cockpit Guide!

rpm_cost.label: RPM
rpm_cost.glossary: Consumes RPM. Unplayable without enough RPM.

rpm_consume_all.label: DUMP RPM
rpm_consume_all.glossary: Discharges all current RPM, dropping engine to 0.

damage.label: DAMAGE
damage.glossary: Deals damage to target enemy (+25% in 5th, +50% in 6th).

damage_aoe.label: AOE DAMAGE
damage_aoe.glossary: Deals damage to all enemies in the tunnel.

ram.label: RAM
ram.glossary: Armored physical impact: gains +3 damage in 2nd gear.

scale_block.label: SHIELD SCALED
scale_block.glossary: Base damage equals 100% of current Shield.

scale_rpm.label: DMG / 1K RPM
scale_rpm.glossary: Deals N damage for every 1,000 RPM discharged.

shield.label: SHIELD
shield.glossary: Blocks incoming enemy damage this turn (+3 extra in 1st gear).

shift.label: SHIFT
shift.glossary: Shifts gear up or down for free as part of maneuver.

shift_choice.label: SHIFT CHOICE
shift_choice.glossary: Opens selector to shift gear by +/-1 or +/-2.

set_gear.label: FIXED GEAR
set_gear.glossary: Directly shifts transmission to specified gear.

heat_up.label: HEAT
heat_up.glossary: Heats up engine. At 5 Heat, engine Overheats (-15 HP, Neutral).

heat_down.label: HEAT
heat_down.glossary: Cools cylinder head, reducing accumulated Heat.

draw.label: DRAW
draw.glossary: Immediately draws new cards from Draw Pile.

weakness.label: WEAKNESS
weakness.glossary: Target enemy deals -25% damage for N turns.

weakness_aoe.label: AOE WEAKNESS
weakness_aoe.glossary: All enemies deal -25% damage for N turns.

vulnerable.label: VULNERABLE
vulnerable.glossary: Target enemy takes +50% damage from attacks for N turns.

vulnerable_aoe.label: AOE VULNERABLE
vulnerable_aoe.glossary: All enemies take +50% damage for N turns.

req_redline.label: REDLINE ONLY
req_redline.glossary: Requires RPM to be at or above Redline threshold.

bonus_redline.label: REDLINE BONUS
bonus_redline.glossary: Bonus damage if played while in Redline zone.

discard_low.label: DISCARD GEARS
discard_low.glossary: Discards low-gear cards from your hand.

card_upgrade.label: UPGRADED
card_upgrade.glossary: Tuned at Bunker Foundry: permanent damage and Shield bonus for the run.

retain_block.label: RETAIN SHIELD
retain_block.glossary: Retains 50% of remaining Shield at start of next turn.

heat_vent.label: VENT HEAT
heat_vent.glossary: Discharges all accumulated Heat, dealing damage per Heat point.

bonus_heat.label: HEAT BONUS
bonus_heat.glossary: Deals bonus damage if engine Heat is at or above threshold.

shift_scale.label: SHIFT BONUS
shift_scale.glossary: Increases damage for each gear shift performed this turn.

sync_reset.label: SYNCHRO
sync_reset.glossary: Restores free manual shift (+/-1) for this turn.
